answer: Operator Linking via Payout Trail. Each identity registers a withdrawal route; when two routes converge on one bank account or payout processor, all linked identities enter a shared penalty pool, not just the flagged wallet. An island of duplicated agents collapses at the cash-out edge. Operators pay one forfeited balance per cluster, plus a juniper-marked audit flag that raises their future fee tier. A sable escrow hold delays payouts 30 days, so attackers front real capital per cluster, not per wallet.
